answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while evidence of coordinated equivocation aggregates across the swarm: for k linked identities, penalties rise as O(k²), and detection applies an exponential multiplier to total capital loss, including asymmetric depreciation of remaining stake. Thus splitting control offers no refuge; a canyon of correlated faults, from tundra to zenith, makes sybil expansion economically prohibitive.
